high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a Twitter thread from the user Cheteshwar Pujara. The tweet is by CricketMAN2 (@man4_cricket) and it reads: "The last Test match at the Gabba, I truly believed that it was a good Pitch, so we could at least Draw the game. But when Rishabh Pant came in, we knew that he was in form. We knew that he can't go for a draw, he had to go for a Victory." - Cheteshwar Pujara The tweet was posted at 4:01 PM on August 9, 2
